learningObjectives: Understand JWT-based authentication and token flow.
Identify common security practices for full stack applications.

activities.title: Auth vs Authorization
activities.instruction: Match security concepts with their responsibilities.

content.concept: Authentication verifies identity, while authorization determines which resources or actions an authenticated user can access.

activities.title: JWT Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a JSON Web Token.

content.concept: A JWT commonly contains a header, payload, and signature used to represent signed claims.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Authentication Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of a login and token flow.

content.concept: A typical token-based login flow verifies credentials, issues a token, and uses that token for protected requests.

activities.title: Security Strategy Lab
activities.instruction: Select the appropriate security control for each scenario.

content.concept: Secure applications use practices such as password hashing, input validation, secure token handling, and access control.
